This implies that L-aspartic acid may influence Slc25a12 through its interaction with Slc25a13, potentially altering the transport activity of Slc25a12. The evidence supports a mechanistic pathway where L-aspartic acid modulates the function of Slc25a13, which in turn affects Slc25a12.
